Container.Name: TranscribeR
Container.Overview: Web UI for transcribing audio through a llama-swap hosted speech-to-text model (whisper.cpp, faster-whisper, etc). Upload audio (auto converted to MP3), follow a synced timestamped transcript while it plays, edit it inline, review segments flagged as uncertain, and export plain text, timestamped text, SRT, VTT or JSON.
Container.Requires: A running llama-swap instance with a transcription model configured (endpoint /v1/audio/transcriptions).

Config.Name: llama-swap URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your llama-swap server (no trailing /v1)

Config.Name: Default model
Config.Description: Model name from your llama-swap config. Users can pick any model in the UI.

Config.Name: llama-swap API key
Config.Description: Only if llama-swap is configured with apiKeys

Config.Name: Default language
Config.Description: ISO code like en. Empty = auto detect

Config.Name: Upstream format
Config.Description: Format sent to the model: mp3, or wav (16kHz mono) if your backend cannot decode mp3

Config.Name: Request timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a transcription (long files on CPU can be slow)

Config.Name: Uncertainty threshold
Config.Description: Default segment confidence below which a segment is flagged (adjustable in UI)

Config.Name: Word threshold
Config.Description: Word probability below which a word is underlined
